newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO slams Israeli decision to build in Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: PLO slams Israeli decision to build in Jerusalem.

text.p: A senior aide to Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Wednesday condemned Israel's decision to build new Jewish housing in Arab East Jerusalem as a serious violation to the peace process.

"The Palestinian Authority rejects this decision and does not recognise the ramifications that may come from the decision to build in Jerusalem," said Ahmed Abdel-Rahman, general secretary of the Palestinian Authority.
"This decision is a serious violation to the peace process and a major blow to the agreements," he told Reuters.

Cabinet Secretary Danny Naveh told reporters that a ministerial committee on Jerusalem approved the construction of 6,500 homes for Jews, with 2,500 to be built in the first stage. Another 3,000 housing units would be built for Arabs.
The decision was made despite warnings that construction on Jabal Abu Ghneim, or Har Homa, may spark Palestinian protests and violence.

Hassan Asfour, a senior PLO peace negotiator with Israel, said Arafat would chair an emergency meeting of the steering committee of the Palestinian negotiating team to discuss the implications of the Israeli decision later on Wednesday.
